svg.text: One Semantic Model in Microsoft Fabric — Portfolio Schedule Risk
A governed semantic model drives the measures, the dashboard, and the ad-hoc Copilot answer — one set of numbers, one source of truth
reads curated gold tables in place
SAP ↔ non-SAP joined on project / WBS
fused DAX index — the load-bearing metric
Risk Band R / A / G · Projects At Risk
Forecast Overrun (SAP FI) · Late POs (SAP MM)
Schedule Slip · Critical Path At Risk
the two signals, side by side
every visual reads the same measures
“Why is Falcon the top risk this month?”
plain language — no report author needed
cites the numbers on the dashboard
real numbers — the artifact Maya needs
The gold tables behind the model are the same curated data used by the agents, RTI, and ontology — one governed semantic layer.
dashboards & Copilot resolve to one model
the KPI card, the drill-down, and the Copilot answer all compute the same Schedule Risk Score — no divergent spreadsheets, one number Maya can defend.
Demo: Executive Portfolio Overview → Falcon is red → drill to Portfolio Schedule Risk (~96) → “Ask Copilot: why?” → cited answer, then “Generate the MPR.”
